decisions.reason: Although maritime customers are familiar, submarine interior lighting is relatively distant from the firm's main knowledge base and the weak website presence suggests too little learning and commercial momentum to justify continued commitment.
The medical examination light disappeared from the website by 2019, indicating poor early traction in a segment that requires knowledge and validation beyond the firm's core lighting competences.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's industrial lighting capabilities, and the 2019 LED replacement kit shows active learning and improvement supported by its in-house R&D.

The designer task light is close to the established offer and its relaunch plus continued standalone presentation suggest the firm can exploit existing design, engineering and market knowledge to keep it viable.
A pendant office luminaire fits the firm's core professional building-lighting business, so its related knowledge and R&D base make continued refinement more attractive than withdrawal.
The premium pendant luminaire is also close to the firm's established office and architectural lighting competences, giving the firm a good basis to learn from the launch and improve it commercially.
